fy27c: The papers, end to end. Logged by the agent, signed for by Sales Support, in by noon, and sent with a transmittal to each department.
Shared work. When a desk is out, the work moves to whoever is in within thirty minutes, at each person's own pace, so no client waits.
What each manager sees. The Branch Manager, the Unit Manager and the BMA each open one page in the morning, and comment under any task, with Branch Intelligence drafting it.
Fact find insights. Every conversation goes on a fact find, and the branch reads them every day: fact finds, applications, and the year's goals.
Our walls, live in the branch. Everyone sees the score, all day, and every win. That's how we build a high-performance branch.
